findings.message: Typical AI-writing phrase; rewrite with a concrete detail.
Aspirin placed on gums or teeth burns the tissue; swallow it as directed.

findings.quote: Placing an aspirin directly against the gum helps numb the pain faster.
findings.why: Placing aspirin on the gum is a known harmful home remedy that can burn oral tissue, and mainstream dental guidance (ADA, NIDCR) explicitly advises against it.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence and advise the reader to take over-the-counter pain relief by mouth as labeled and to avoid putting aspirin or other pain tablets on the gums.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on dental emergencies](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/dental-emergencies) lists common cases and what to do.
findings.why: I cannot confirm from here that this exact MouthHealthy URL is live, so the citation is unverified.
findings.fix: Open the link before publishing and confirm it resolves to the ADA page on dental emergencies, or link to the MouthHealthy topic index instead.

findings.quote: get to a dentist as quickly as possible
findings.why: For a knocked-out tooth, the post omits the commonly cited time window (ideally within about 30 minutes) that makes replantation more likely to succeed.
findings.fix: Add that the tooth has the best chance of saving if a dentist sees it within about 30 minutes, and check the wording against the ADA page once the link is verified.

findings.quote: In today's fast-paced world, dental emergencies rarely happen at a convenient time.
findings.why: The opening generic phrase is a stock AI-writing pattern that adds nothing specific for the reader.
findings.fix: Open with a concrete scenario, such as a tooth knocked out during sports or a toothache that wakes someone at night.

findings.quote: Our emergency dental care is led by Dr. Elena Marsh.
findings.why: The ficha lists emergency care among Dr. Marsh's focus areas, but 'led by' implies a管理 role the ficha does not state.
findings.fix: Reword to 'Dr. Elena Marsh, who focuses on emergency care, treats emergency patients,' or a similar phrasing that matches the ficha.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: This demo disclaimer is accurate for the QA fixture but would tell real readers the clinic is fake if the post goes live as-is.
findings.fix: Remove this paragraph when the post is adapted for a real clinic, and keep the ficha's fictional flag as the source of truth for the demo.
